title: GOOD MORNING SON OF GOD
text: I want you to lift up your hands right there where you [music] are seated. Just lift up your hands onto the Lord. I decree over your life this morning every satanic cobweb that has been woven around your destiny. I command it to catch fire in the name [music] of Jesus. Every agenda of hell that has been programmed to frustrate your day, your week, your month, I command angelic intervention in the [music] name of Jesus. Father, we thank you because you are the God who neither slumbers nor sleeps. We thank you because before we call, you answer. And [music] while we are yet speaking, you hear. We bless your name this morning. Now, I want to talk to you [music] about something that will revolutionize your identity as a believer. The Bible says [music] in 1 John chapter 3 verse 1, "Behold what manner of love the Father has bestowed upon us that we should be [music] called the sons of God." Not that we hope to become, not that we are aspiring to be, but that we are indeed called the sons of God. This is [music] not you are working toward. This is an identity that has been conferred upon you by the blood of Jesus Christ. And [music] because the world did not know him, the world knows us not. You see, when you wake up in the morning, the first consciousness that should flood your spirit is [music] not the consciousness of your problems, not the consciousness of your limitations, [music] not the consciousness of what you lack. The first consciousness that should [music] flood your spirit when you open your eyes is the consciousness of whose son you are. You are not an orphan [music] in this universe. You are not a wanderer without a father. You are not struggling to find identity. The moment you receive Jesus Christ, you were translated from the kingdom of darkness into the [music] kingdom of the son of his love, and you became a son of the most high God. Now, I need you to understand something about sonship. Sonship is different from servanthood. A servant works for wages. [music] A son works from inheritance. A servant is motivated by fear. A son is motivated by love. A servant can be dismissed at any time. A son [music] has permanent residency in the Father's house. And the Bible says in Galatians chapter 4, "And because you are sons, God has sent [music] forth the spirit of his son into your hearts crying, 'Abba Father.' Therefore, you are [music] no longer a slave, but a son. And if a son, then an heir of God through Christ." So, this morning, I am addressing you not as a struggling believer, not as someone who is barely making it, not as someone who is at the mercy of circumstances. [music] I am addressing you as a son of God, as an heir of God, as a joint [music] heir with Christ Jesus. Everything that belongs to your Father belongs to you. The Bible says in [music] Romans 8:28, "And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose." [music] Not some things, all all things. The good, the bad, the difficult, the challenging, the mysterious, all of it is working [music] together for your good because you are a son. Let me tell you what happens when you operate from the consciousness of sonship. When you [music] operate from the consciousness of sonship, you don't beg. Sons don't beg, they ask. There is a difference between [music] begging and asking. When a beggar comes to you, he has no legal right to what you have. He's appealing to your mercy. But when a son comes to his father, >> [music] >> he's not appealing to mercy alone. He's appealing to covenant, to relationship, to the legal [music] rights that sonship confers. Jesus said in Matthew 7:11, "If you then, [music] being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him?" [music] So, this morning, I want you to begin to operate from the consciousness that [music] you are a son. When you pray, you are not praying as an outsider hoping [music] God hears you. You are praying as a son who has been given the right to approach the throne of grace with boldness. Hebrews 4:16 says, "Let us therefore come [music] boldly to the throne of grace that we may obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need." Boldly, not timidly, not apologetically, not as though you are not sure if God wants to [music] hear from you. You come boldly because you are a son. Now, let me show you something about the power of knowing who you are. When Satan came to tempt Jesus in the wilderness, [music] how did he begin his temptation? He said, "If you are the son of God, command that these stones become bread." [music] He was attacking Jesus' identity. He was trying to make Jesus question who he was. And you see, if the enemy could make Jesus doubt his sonship, then everything else would have collapsed. [music] But Jesus knew who he was. His identity was not up for debate. His sonship [music] was not a matter of conjecture. He knew he was the son of God. And that is exactly what the enemy tries to do to you every single day. He tries to make you forget who you are. He brings circumstances that contradict your sonship. He brings situations that make you feel like an orphan, like someone who has been abandoned, like someone who has to fight and [music] struggle and beg and plead just to get by. Do you know what that means? It means you carry the DNA of divinity. It means you have been made a partaker of the divine nature. 2 Peter 1:4 says, "By which [music] have been given to us exceedingly great and precious promises, that through this you may be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption [music] that is in the world through lust."
